label: Descriptive reference, fitted on 3 completed cycles (2015-2022); not a tested rating and not a forecast.
source: CoinMetrics community CapMVRVCur and CapMrktCurUSD (daily close basis); ETF flows from bitbo.io daily BTC totals. Rebuilt monthly by research/cycle_bottoms.py (.github/workflows/v2-cycle-bottoms.yml).

currentCycle.confirm_rule: joins the fit after 365 days with no lower MVRV

band.size_fit_why: bottom MVRV vs log10(realized cap), 2015-2022 cycles: -0.369 + 0.097 x log10(realized cap USD), at $1.07T
band.scaled_why: size fit scaled by this cycle's compression: peak MVRV 2.78 vs 3.69 predicted by the same size fit (0.66 of the expected excess)
band.exponential_why: exponential through the confirmed cycle bottoms (0.56, 0.69, 0.75)

etf.note: New ETF coins since Jan 2024 hold about 2.9% of supply at about $85.6k average cost; they lift the realized price by about $962 (1.8%).
